parsed.title: Unverified claim in Planning evidence
parsed.detail: PE-003 claims the fix follows the same defect-class pattern as review-change's commit 29b52c63, but explicitly marks it as ASSUMPTION-UNVERIFIED because git cat-file fails. The SPEC states 'Known pre-existing issues: none recorded', but this unverified dependency on a non-existent commit object is a pre-existing integrity issue in the unit's own evidence.

parsed.title: Obligation O4 missing from Obligations table
parsed.detail: The Progress log at line 206 states 'O1–O6 minus O4 folded into O1–O3', implying O4 was removed. However, the Obligations table (lines 185-204) only lists O1, O2, O3, O5, O6. O4 is completely absent, creating a gap in the obligation ledger. The validator for O4 is not present, and no other obligation references it.

parsed.title: Progress log contradicts SPEC structure
parsed.detail: The Progress log claims 'O1–O6 minus O4 folded into O1–O3', but the Obligations table has O5 and O6 separate. The numbering is non-sequential (O1, O2, O3, O5, O6) without explanation in the table or notes, violating the implicit contract of sequential obligation IDs in the ledger.

parsed.title: Needs-input guard duplicates Turn contract logic
parsed.detail: The 'Needs-input guard' section (lines 47-60) repeats the exact same re-ask/halt logic already stated in the Turn contract box (lines 21-24). While not a defect in behavior, it violates the 'no duplicated code' axis by repeating the contract enforcement prose in two places, increasing maintenance risk.

parsed.title: Needs-input guard duplicates Turn contract logic
parsed.detail: The 'Needs-input guard' section (lines 34-45) repeats the exact same re-ask/halt logic already stated in the Turn contract box (lines 34-37). This duplication increases maintenance risk and violates the 'no duplicated code' axis.

parsed.title: Needs-input guard duplicates Turn contract logic
parsed.detail: The 'Needs-input guard' section (lines 34-47) repeats the exact same re-ask/halt logic already stated in the Turn contract box (lines 21-24). This duplication increases maintenance risk and violates the 'no duplicated code' axis.
